mapper.select: select from arc_borrow b join arc_archive a on a.archive_id = b.archive_id where b.borrow_id = #{borrowId}
mapper.insert: insert into arc_borrow (borrow_no, archive_id, applicant_id, applicant_name, applicant_dept_id, reason, start_date, end_date, borrow_status, approval_level, version, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{borrowNo}, #{archiveId}, #{applicantId}, #{applicantName}, #{applicantDeptId}, #{reason}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{borrowStatus}, #{approvalLevel}, 0, #{createBy}, now(), coalesce(#{remark}, ''))
mapper.select: select count(1) from arc_borrow where archive_id = #{archiveId} and borrow_status in ('PENDING','APPROVED','LENT')
select count(1) from arc_borrow where borrow_no like concat(#{prefix},'%')
select archive_id, archive_code, title, archive_status, del_flag, category_id, secret_level, dept_id from arc_archive where archive_id = #{archiveId}
mapper.update: update arc_borrow set borrow_status = 'APPROVED', current_approver_id = #{approverId}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now(), version = version + 1 where borrow_id = #{borrowId} and borrow_status = 'PENDING'

update arc_borrow set borrow_status = 'LENT', lend_by = #{lendBy}, lend_at = now(), update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now(), version = version + 1 where borrow_id = #{borrowId} and borrow_status = 'APPROVED'

update arc_borrow set borrow_status = 'RETURNED', return_by = #{returnBy}, return_at = now(), actual_return_date = curdate(), update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now(), version = version + 1 where borrow_id = #{borrowId} and borrow_status = 'LENT'
mapper.insert: insert into arc_approval_record (borrow_id, approval_level, approver_id, approver_name, result, opinion, handled_at) values (#{borrowId}, #{approvalLevel}, #{approverId}, #{approverName}, #{result}, #{opinion}, #{handledAt})
mapper.select: select record_id, borrow_id, approval_level, approver_id, approver_name, result, opinion, handled_at from arc_approval_record where borrow_id = #{borrowId} order by handled_at, record_id
